text:
Rae: Quick flag 
I found two user-facing mismatches in Console observability docs: the KV cache examples still use `kv_prefix` (SDK renamed to `kv_key_prefix` in v1.14) and the dashboard sample uses `trace_context_id` (now `trace_id`). Can we patch both?

Omar: I'll open a small docs PR to replace the params and add a short note: "requires SDK >= v1.14". Will also update the playground embed URL (old host 404).

Talia: Good. Please also add a CI check to assert the rendered page includes the exact snippet line `trace = TraceHook(kv_key_prefix="user:session:")`. We have a lightweight pytest harness under `scripts/snippet-tests`.

docs-bot: Link-checker: broken link found -> /playground/old-embed (line ~140).

engineer-sdks: We can add a non-breaking shim in the next minor release, but agree docs should match current public SDK.

Rae: Plan: Omar pushes PR with snippet fixes + playground URL + CI snippet test, Talia reviews CI, engineer-sdks files a shim ticket. Merge after staging preview passes.

Omar: PR created: #8801 (checks running). Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-8801 (expires in 6 days).

Talia: Reviewing now.
